title: Balancing Prayer Times at the Office
paragraphs: Malik memulai pekerjaan baru. Perusahaannya tidak memiliki ruang shalat. Ia tidak yakin bagaimana shalat saat hari sibuk dengan banyak rapat. Pada minggu pertama, Malik bertanya kepada manajernya. Ia bertanya apakah boleh memakai ruang rapat kosong beberapa menit saat Dzuhur. Ia khawatir orang lain tidak menyukai permintaan itu.

Manajernya langsung setuju. Rekan kerja lain sudah melakukan hal yang sama. Malik melihat bahwa ia terlalu khawatir dan tidak ada orang di kantor yang marah. Satu bulan kemudian, Malik memiliki jeda shalat dalam rencana hariannya. Ia bersyukur karena bertanya dengan jelas, bukan khawatir diam-diam.
answerKey: Malik starts a new job. His company does not have a prayer room. He is not sure how to pray during a busy day with many meetings. In his first week, Malik asks his manager a question. He asks if he can use an empty meeting room for a few minutes at Dhuhr. He worries that people may not like the request. His manager agrees at once. Another coworker already does something similar. Malik sees that he worried too much and that no one at the office is upset. One month later, Malik has prayer breaks in his daily plan. He is grateful that he asked clearly instead of worrying in silence.
